important_notes: Opportunity Number: CDC-RFA-DP-27-0076 — Agency: Centers for Disease Control - NCCDPHP.
Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity CDC-RFA-DP-27-0076.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.

funded_activities.activity: Eligible activities supporting Promoting Cancer Surveillance Workforce, Education, and Data Use: This notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) will help build a workforce that's prepared to collect and use high-quality cancer data. This work is essential to understand the impact of cancer and inform public health action, research, and policy.  ...
